name: Imperfection
overview: Scripture reveals that although mankind was created in God's image, humans are inherently imperfect and sinful, as no one on earth is entirely just or without sin. This imperfection results in separation from God due to iniquities that hide His face from us. Yet, Jesus offers abundant life despite our flaws, calling believers to strive for the perfection exemplified by our heavenly Father, while recognizing the need for grace amid human shortcomings.
